t1_p1.title: Longevity and Daily Health Routines
paragraphs: Living a long and vigorous life is not merely a consequence of fortunate genetics; it is deeply shaped by our daily health routines. Nutritional scientists consistently emphasize the (11) __________ of consuming balanced meals rich in natural vitamins, dietary fiber, and essential minerals. In addition, individuals who regularly (12) __________ in moderate physical exercise—such as brisk walking or swimming—tend to maintain superior cardiovascular fitness and lower body fat levels.

(13) __________, achieving longevity requires more than just dietary care and physical movement. Chronic emotional distress can severely weaken the body’s natural defenses over time. Therefore, modern health specialists strongly advise people to (14) __________ their daily screen exposure and spend time outdoors to alleviate tension. Cultivating positive relationships also helps people overcome anxiety and (15) __________ their mental resilience throughout the aging process.

t1_p2.title: The Modern Generation Gap in America
paragraphs: The generation gap that was so in evidence during the 60s has resurfaced, but it is not the disruptive force that it was during the Vietnam era, a 2009 study suggests. The Pew Research Center study found that 79% of Americans see major differences between younger and older adults in the way they look at the world. In 1969, a Gallup Poll found that a smaller percentage, 74%, perceived major differences.

Today, however, although more Americans see generational differences, most do not see them as divisive. That is partly because of the areas of difference. The top areas of disagreement between young and old, according to the Pew Research Study, are the use of technology and taste in music. Grandparents are likely to have observed these differences in their grandchildren who are tweens, teens, and young adults.
If large differences between the generations exist, why don't they spawn conflict? The answer is twofold.

First, the two largest areas of difference technology and music are less emotionally charged than political issues. The older generation is likely to be proud of the younger generation's prowess in technology rather than to view it as a problem. As for the musical differences, each generation wants its own style of music, and the older generation generally can relate to that desire.

Second, in the other areas of difference, the younger generation tends to regard the older generation as superior to their own generation—clearly a difference from the 1960s with its rallying cry of "Don't trust anyone over thirty." According to the Pew study, all generations regard older Americans as superior in moral values, work ethic and respect for others.

items.instruction: Mark the letter A, B, C or D on your answer sheet to indicate the best arrangement of utterances or sentences to make a meaningful exchange or text.
items.instruction_vi: Chọn A, B, C hoặc D để sắp xếp các câu thành đoạn đối thoại hợp lý và có nghĩa.
items.prompt:
Arrange the following sentences into a meaningful exchange:
a. Nam: Yes, we argued about my career choice. My parents want me to follow in their footsteps, but I prefer graphic design.
b. Lan: Did you have an argument with your parents again? You look quite stressed.
c. Lan: I think you should sit down and calmly explain your passion and future plan to them.
d. Nam: Thank you for the advice, Lan. I’ll give it a try tonight.
items.explanation:
Thứ tự hội thoại tự nhiên:
1. (b) Lan mở lời hỏi thăm: 'Bạn lại cãi nhau với bố mẹ à? Trông bạn căng thẳng thế.'
2. (a) Nam trả lời lý do: 'Ừ, tụi mình cãi nhau về định hướng nghề nghiệp...'
3. (c) Lan đưa ra lời khuyên: 'Mình nghĩ bạn nên ngồi xuống bình tĩnh giải thích...'
4. (d) Nam cảm ơn: 'Cảm ơn lời khuyên nhé, mình sẽ thử vào tối nay.'
→ Thứ tự đúng: b – a – c – d.

items.instruction: Mark the letter A, B, C or D on your answer sheet to indicate the best arrangement of utterances or sentences to make a meaningful exchange or text.

items.prompt:
Arrange the following sentences into a coherent paragraph:
a. In addition, disagreements frequently arise over how teenagers dress and spend their free time.
b. The generation gap can lead to significant conflicts between parents and children.
c. For instance, while older family members value traditional customs, young people often embrace modern digital trends.
d. To bridge this divide, both generations need to listen actively and respect each other's perspectives.
e. One primary cause of these misunderstandings is the noticeable difference in values and lifestyles.
options: A. b – a – c – e – d
B. b – e – c – a – d
C. e – c – b – a – d
D. b – e – a – c – d
items.explanation:
Cấu trúc đoạn văn chuẩn logic:
• (b) Câu chủ đề (Topic sentence): Khoảng cách thế hệ dẫn đến xung đột lớn.
• (e) Nêu nguyên nhân cốt lõi: Sự khác biệt rõ rệt về giá trị sống và phong cách sống.
• (c) Đưa ví dụ minh họa: Người lớn giữ truyền thống, người trẻ theo xu hướng số.
• (a) Bổ sung ví dụ thứ 2: Cách ăn mặc và sử dụng thời gian rảnh rỗi.
• (d) Câu kết luận / giải pháp: Cần tích cực lắng nghe và tôn trọng nhau.
→ Thứ tự đúng: b – e – c – a – d.

items.prompt: Visitors are not allowed to touch any artifacts displayed in the museum. (Using MUSTN’T)

Visitors mustn't touch any of the artifacts displayed in the museum.
Visitors must not touch any artifacts displayed in the museum.
items.explanation: Cấu trúc: 'be not allowed to + V' (không được phép) = 'mustn't + V-bare' (cấm không được làm gì).

items.prompt: The volunteers began cleaning up the community park two hours ago. (Using present perfect tense)
model_answers: The volunteers have cleaned up the community park for two hours.
The volunteers have been cleaning up the community park for two hours.

items.section_vi: V. VIẾT: TẠO CÂU TỪ TỪ GỢI Ý
items.instruction: Use the cues given to write complete and meaningful sentences. Make any necessary changes.
items.instruction_vi: Dùng các từ gợi ý để viết câu hoàn chỉnh, thêm hoặc biến đổi từ nếu cần.
items.prompt: Although / install / solar lights / be / expensive, / switch / to / renewable energy / help / households / cut / power bills.
model_answers: Although installing solar lights is expensive, switching to renewable energy helps households cut power bills.
Although installing solar lights is expensive, switching to renewable energy helps households cut down power bills.
Although installing solar lights is expensive, switching to renewable energy helps households cut their power bills.
items.explanation:
• Mệnh đề nhượng bộ: Danh động từ 'Installing solar lights' làm chủ ngữ số ít → 'is expensive'.
• Mệnh đề chính: Danh động từ 'switching to renewable energy' làm chủ ngữ số ít → động từ 'helps'.
• Cấu trúc: 'help someone (to) do something' → 'helps households cut power bills'.

items.explanation:
• Chủ ngữ gồm hai thành tố 'Mutual respect and active listening' (danh từ số nhiều) → to be chia là 'are'.
• Cấu trúc: 'be necessary to do something' (cần thiết để làm gì) → 'are necessary to bridge the generation gap between parents and children'.

t2_p2.title: Super Size Me: An Experiment with Fast Food
paragraphs: Super Size Me is a 2004 film by Morgan Spurlock, in which he documents his experiment to eat only McDonald's fast food three times a day, every day, for thirty days.

Spurlock made himself a short list of rules for the experiment, including an obligation to eat all of the three meals he ordered. He also had to 'Super Size', which means accepting a giant portion every time the option was offered to him. He ended up vomiting after the first Super Size meal he finished, after taking nearly twenty minutes to consume it.

After five days Spurlock put on almost 5kg, and he soon found himself feeling depressed, with no energy. The only thing that got rid of his headaches and made him feel better was another McDonald's meal, so his doctors told him he was addicted. More seriously, around day twenty, he started experiencing heart palpitations and one of the doctors detected liver problems. However, in spite of his doctor's advice, Spurlock continued to the end of the month and achieved a total weight gain of 11kg. His body mass index also increased from a healthy 23.2 to an overweight 27.

It took Spurlock fifteen months to recover from his experiment and return to his original weight, but the film also had a wider impact. Just after its showing in 2004, McDonald's phased out the Super Size option and healthier options like salads appeared on the menu.
Unfortunately, McDonald's denied the connection between the film and the changes, but it is interesting to note how closely they coincided with the release of the film.

t3_p1.title: Secrets of Longevity in the Blue Zones
paragraphs: Living a long and fulfilling life is not merely a matter of genetic luck; it depends heavily on everyday lifestyle choices. Residents of the famous "Blue Zones"—regions where people regularly live past 100—share several common habits. First and foremost, their diets consist primarily of plant-based foods, such as beans, nuts, and fresh vegetables. (11) __________ people in these areas consume red meat, doing so only on special occasions. Regular, natural movement is another vital component. Rather than lifting heavy weights in gyms, they engage (12) __________ physical activities through walking, gardening, and doing manual household chores.

(13) __________, managing chronic stress is indispensable for emotional balance and cardiovascular fitness. Blue Zone dwellers intentionally slow down each day to pray, take naps, or visit their neighbours. Strong social connections also play an instrumental role. They cultivate lifelong bonds, which provides them with a strong sense of belonging and helps (14) __________ their life expectancy. (15) __________, maintaining healthy routines along with loving relationships is the true recipe for enduring vitality.

t3_p2.title: Sleep Duration and Cardiovascular & Cognitive Health
paragraphs: In recent years, the scientific community has paid increasing attention to the profound relationship between sleep duration and physical well-being. Chronic sleep deprivation has ceased to be viewed as a harmless consequence of modern ambition; instead, it is recognized as a direct risk factor for severe cardiovascular diseases, obesity, and impaired immune function. When individuals sleep less than six hours per night on a consistent basis, their bodies release excessive cortisol—a hormone that triggers systemic inflammation and damages arterial walls.

During slow-wave deep sleep, the brain activates the glymphatic system, a specialized cleansing mechanism that clears metabolic waste products accumulated throughout the waking day. Among these toxins is beta-amyloid, a protein strongly associated with cognitive decline. Depriving oneself of restorative rest inhibits this vital detoxification process.

Moreover, inadequate rest significantly interferes with appetite-regulating hormones. It reduces leptin, which signals fullness, while increasing ghrelin, the compound responsible for stimulating hunger. Consequently, sleep-deprived individuals experience intense cravings for foods high in saturated fat and refined sugars. Medical practitioners advocate establishing strict bedtime routines and eliminating screen exposure at least one hour before turning in. Ensuring seven to eight hours of sound rest nightly remains one of the simplest yet most potent strategies for sustaining optimal health.
